headline: Vikings Trade QB J.J. McCarthy To Giants
summary: J.J. McCarthy’s tenure in Minnesota is coming to an end. The third-year quarterback will receive a fresh start in New York via an in-season trade. McCarthy is being dealt from the Vikings to the Giants, as first reported by The Ringer’s Tom Pelissero. Minnesota will receive a 2027 fifth-round pick in return. headline: Panthers CB Jaycee Horn Facing Extended Absence
summary: The Panthers may need to finish the 2026 season without their top cornerback. Jaycee Horn exited Sunday’s loss, and a lengthy absence is in store. Horn suffered a torn quad, NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport reports. An indefinite absence and a move to injured reserve will now be required. Rapoport adds a second opinion is being sought out […]

headline: Sources: Panthers OL Damien Lewis (UCL injury) to miss time
summary: Panthers left guard Damien Lewis has a UCL injury in his elbow and will be out a few weeks, sources told NFL Network's Mike Garafolo and Ian Rapoport.

headline: Ben Johnson praises Case Keenum, doesn't say who Bears' starting QB will be next week
